D: A K-pop girl group who secretly hunt demons face a rival boy band with a dark secret.
P: Serve the ramyeon when the girls finally get their noodle break.
S: Sushi rice and nori rolls with omelette, carrot and vegetables

Rice, egg, carrot, spinach, pickled radish and ham rolled in seaweed and sliced into rounds. Season 300g cooked sushi rice with sesame oil and salt. Lay rice on 4 nori sheets, add strips of omelette from 2 eggs, sautéed carrot, blanched spinach and pickled radish, then roll tightly and slice into rounds.
refuelling between shows to keep the Honmoon strong

Chewy rice cakes and fish cake simmered in a sticky gochujang and anchovy broth, blanketed in melted mozzarella with spring onion and sesame. Soak 500g rice cakes in warm water for 10 minutes. Bring 500ml water with 1 tsp dashi powder to the boil. Stir in 3 tbsp gochujang, 1 tbsp gochugaru, 1 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp sugar and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Add the rice cakes and 2 sliced fish cakes and simmer 10 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy. Add 3 chopped spring onions, scatter 150g grated mozzarella over, cover for 2 minutes to melt and finish with sesame seeds.
Frankfurter and mozzarella skewers, battered, fried, then ketchup and mustard
Korean hot dogs on a stick: sausage wrapped in mozzarella and a thick batter, fried crisp, rolled in sugar and finished with ketchup and mustard.
M: Spicy ramen with kimchi, a cracked egg and melted cheese
Spicy instant-style noodles upgraded with a soft egg, spring onion, kimchi and a slice of cheese.
the three of them sharing a comfort meal

Milky beef bone broth simmered for hours, with sliced brisket, rice and noodles, seasoned at the table with salt and spring onion, radish kimchi alongside. Soak 2kg beef marrow bones and 600g brisket in cold water for 1 hour. Boil the bones 10 minutes, drain and rinse. Cover with 4L fresh water, boil hard with the lid off for 3 hours, topping up, until milky. Add the brisket for the last 90 minutes, then slice it thin. Cook 100g somyeon noodles. Serve bowls of broth with brisket, noodles, cooked rice, sliced spring onion, salt and pepper to season, and 300g radish kimchi.
W: Chewy fried yeast pancakes filled with brown sugar, cinnamon and walnut

Yeasted dough filled with brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts, pan-fried until crisp and molten inside. Mix 300g flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tbsp sugar and 220ml warm milk into a sticky dough and prove 1 hour. Fill 8 balls with 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 40g chopped walnuts, flatten in an oiled pan and fry 2 minutes a side until crisp.
K: Ginger, yuja citron and honey tea with lemon, hot or iced

Sweet and sour yuja citron marmalade stirred into hot water with fresh ginger and honey, served steaming in glasses or poured over ice with lemon. Simmer 1L water with a 3cm knob of ginger, sliced thin, for 5 minutes. Take off the heat and stir in 6 tbsp yuja citron tea (the honey citron marmalade from Asian grocers) and 2 tbsp honey until dissolved. Pour into 4 heatproof glasses, making sure each gets some citron peel, and add a thin lemon slice. For an iced version, cool it and pour over ice.
